Ambiguity.description: Why you cannot tell where to search.

reason.description: homonym: the name fits several places and nothing says which one. city_needed: the place is named after a city it is NOT in ("gare de Lyon" is a station in Paris): then give no city. Not when the place is in that city ("vieux Lyon" is in Lyon). too_vague: no searchable place ("somewhere nice").
reason.title: Reason

Ambiguity.title: Ambiguity

mention.description: The user's exact words for the city, as written. Empty when not written in this message.
mention.title: Mention

region.description: Code of the state or province of the city, when known ("CT"). Else null.
region.title: Region

country.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 country of the city ("FR"). Null when unsure.
country.title: Country

Exclusion.description: A place the user wants to avoid.

mention.description: The user's exact words for the place, as written.
mention.title: Mention

Exclusion.title: Exclusion

mention.description: The user's exact words for the place, copied as written, typos included.
mention.title: Mention

canonical.description: The place's correct full name, spelling fixed ("champs elysee" -> "Champs-Élysées", "St Paul's" in London -> "St Paul's Cathedral").
canonical.title: Canonical

city.description: The city the place is in, from your knowledge when the user did not write it ("Buckingham Palace" -> "London", "le Louvre" -> "Paris", "times square" -> "New York"). null only when places of that name are in several cities ("Gare du Nord": Paris and Brussels), when the place is named after a city it is not in ("gare de Lyon"), or when the place is itself a city.
city.title: City

country.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country the place is in ("FR"), from your knowledge. null when unsure.
country.title: Country

postal_code.description: The postcode or ZIP code exactly as written ("75009"), also when the postcode alone is the place ("dans le 75009"). null when none is written.
postal_code.title: Postal Code

region.description: Code of the state or province the place is in, when known ("CT"). Else null.
region.title: Region

city_inferred.description: true when `city` comes from your knowledge, false when the user wrote it.
city_inferred.title: City Inferred

description: Where the user wants to search, as understood from the message. Never coordinates.

places.description: The places named in THIS message, most important first, at most 2. Empty when the message names no place.
places.title: Places

city.description: The city of the search: written in the message, or kept from the earlier request when this message names none. Null when unknown.

country_named.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 code of a country the user NAMED in words ("in Italy" -> "IT"). Null when no country is written: never guess here.
country_named.title: Country Named

region_named.description: Code of a state or province the user NAMED ("Milford ct" -> "CT"). Else null.
region_named.title: Region Named

relation.description: in: inside the place. near: around it ("near", "close to"). whole_city: anywhere in the city.
relation.title: Relation

carryover.description: How this message relates to the earlier destination. new: a new destination. keep: no new place, same destination. replace_place_keep_city: a new place in the same city. refine: narrows the earlier destination.
carryover.title: Carryover

exclusions.description: Places the user wants to AVOID ("not in NYC"). Usually empty.
exclusions.title: Exclusions

ambiguity.description: Null in most cases. Set only when you cannot tell where to search.

title: GeoIntent
